How long does 1-60 take in WoW Forever?

WoW Forever launches on 4 November 2026, with beta open since 17 September 2026. Blizzard confirmed the 1-60 XP curve is unchanged from Classic, so reaching 60 is still 4,084,700 XP. What changed is where that XP comes from: dungeon mob XP is reduced and dungeon quest XP is raised, which is meant to stop dungeon spam beating questing the way it does on Classic Era realms.

1-60: hours to cap by play style, no XP bonus active
Play styleCasualAverageOptimized
Questing~103 h~62 h~39 h
Dungeon grinding~170 h~102 h~64 h
Mixed~99 h~59 h~37 h
PvP~294 h~176 h~110 h

Forever also adds new leveling ground. Zephras Isle covers 1-12 for the Skyborne, The Riverglades adds 150+ quests in the awkward 35-45 bracket, Desolace and the Wetlands get expanded questing, and Krol'dok Stronghold is a 40-45 outdoor dungeon. That extra content matters most in the 30s and 40s, where vanilla routes traditionally run thin.

Forever rates are pre-launch estimates. The XP requirements are firm because the curve is unchanged, but the XP/hour bands - the dungeon ones especially - will be revised once players report live numbers after launch.

XP bonuses available

An XP bonus never changes how much XP a level costs - it changes how fast you earn it, so a +20% bonus cuts roughly 17% off the time rather than 20%. These are the bonuses that apply in this version.

XP bonuses in WoW Forever
BonusValue
Rested XP (typical play)+15%
Always rested (alt / short sessions)+30%
Joyous Journeys-style buff, if enabled+50%

The two rested options describe the same buff at different intensities, so they never stack with each other - ticking one unticks the other. Everything else adds together. See how the numbers work for what sits behind the XP/hour rates.

Frequently asked questions

How long will 1-60 take in WoW Forever?

The 1-60 XP curve in WoW Forever is unchanged from Classic, so it is still 4,084,700 XP. Because dungeon mob XP is cut and dungeon quest XP is raised, questing is meant to be the fastest route: roughly 103 hours casual, 62 hours average and 39 hours optimized. These are pre-launch estimates and will be revised once live data lands.

Is WoW Forever faster to level than Classic Era?

Yes, on these estimates. The XP requirement is identical at 4,084,700 XP, but Forever pays more quest XP per hour and adds zones that remove the dead spots in the 30s and 40s, so an average questing run lands near 62 hours against roughly 71 hours on Classic Era.

Do heirlooms or XP buffs work in WoW Forever?

Heirlooms do not exist in WoW Forever, so rested XP is the practical bonus. The calculator also carries a Joyous Journeys-style +50% option so you can model what a launch or catch-up buff would do if Blizzard enables one.

Should I level in dungeons in WoW Forever?

Not as your main route. Dungeon mob XP is reduced on purpose, and dungeon grinding comes out around 102 hours at an average pace against 62 for questing. Dungeon quests are worth more than they were in Classic, so running a dungeon for its quests as part of a questing route is still worthwhile.
